headline: Nolan Jimbo Joins Whitney Museum as Arnhold Associate Curator
summary: The Whitney Museum of American Art has appointed Nolan Jimbo as Arnhold Associate Curator. Jimbo comes to the Whitney from the Museum of Contemporary Art Chicago (MCA), where he served as an assistant curator with a focus on Asian diasporic artists and abstraction. Jimbo replaces Rujeko Hockley, who co-curated the 2019 Whitney Biennial, among other exhibtions.
